description: Receives MIDI carried inside an audio signal, so a plugin hosted in VCV Host can send MIDI back into Rack; it decodes eight such streams and offers them to the rest of Rack as MIDI devices

params.text: Trims the level of the jack beside it until the lamp reads green, which is where the decoded bytes land exactly; the range is narrow because the level has to be right to the sample

inputs.text: The audio from a MIDI over Audio plugin, one sample per MIDI byte, with a negative sample ending each message

notes: adding this module registers a MIDI driver called MIDI over Audio, carrying eight devices named Port 1 to Port 8.
to use what arrives at a jack, open any MIDI module in Rack, choose the MIDI over Audio driver, and choose the port of the same number as the jack.
the lamp beside each jack reads the level: green is exact, yellow and orange are close, blue means the signal is too quiet and red that it is too loud.
the lamps are drawn by the module and are not controls; they cannot be clicked.
only three-byte MIDI messages are passed on; the decoder has a fixed three-byte buffer.
menu: Panic — sends a note-off for all 128 notes on all 16 MIDI channels of all eight ports
